title: Vertices, options, and two trigrams: context and action (2026-10-22)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
So, these 8 different types should become stable definitions of the forms decisions can take. 

Not every decision can have options at all vertices. 

So, we can map the final decision to a vertex... But can decision types exist as decisions that present specific types of options?

Ful Yang decisions focus on action, movement, and specific goals. 


Or is trying to collapse to just 8 types like this missing dimensions?

The i-ching uses two sets of trigrams. The context and the action. So there may need to be different classifications working I. Prallel
